projects.title: Build a prompt testing lab
projects.description: Compare two prompts with a test set you can trust.
requirements: Access to an AI assistant of your choice
Six invented support messages without personal data
steps: Define billing, technical, and unclear labels and write expected labels for six messages.
Write a minimal prompt, then a second prompt with examples and an ambiguity rule.
Run both prompts on the same messages. Record outputs and any formatting failures.
Compute label accuracy for each version and inspect every disagreement.
Add two difficult cases and write a short recommendation based on quality and effort.
criteria: All eight cases have expected and observed outputs.
The comparison uses the same cases and model settings.
The recommendation names one limitation and a next experiment.

projects.title: Design a grounded knowledge assistant
projects.description: Take a small document collection from questions to cited answers.
requirements: Five short public or invented documents
A way to inspect retrieved passages
steps: Assign source IDs, dates, and access labels to the documents.
Split at section boundaries and preserve source metadata.
Create ten answerable questions and three unanswerable questions with known evidence.
Implement simple keyword retrieval as a baseline and supply top passages to a model manually or through a server.
Review citations and abstentions; record missing evidence separately from generation errors.
criteria: Every answer links to a source passage.
Unanswerable cases are labeled as unsupported.
Restricted content is excluded before generation.
A table separates retrieval failures from answer failures.

projects.title: Plan an AI MVP that earns its place
projects.description: Turn one real workflow into a measurable delivery plan.
requirements: A baseline estimate of time and volume
steps: Describe the user and the current task in one paragraph.
Estimate volume, task time, review time, and failure impact.
Choose a narrow scope with explicit exclusions.
Write five acceptance criteria and an evaluation plan.
Create a risk register and a go/no-go recommendation with named owners.
criteria: Benefits include human review and operating costs.
Each acceptance criterion has a measurable threshold.
Every major risk has an owner and testable mitigation.

projects.title: Design a support agent with human approval
projects.description: Specify tools, limits, and an approval step before any code is written.
requirements: A support scenario with invented data
The agent workflows and security lessons
steps: List every tool the agent could use and mark each one read-only or consequential.
Write the input schema and permission check for each tool.
Draw the loop with a step budget, a timeout, and a stop condition.
Design the approval screen: recipient, exact action, evidence, approve and reject.
Write five test cases, including a retrieved document that contains an injected instruction.
criteria: No consequential tool can run without an approval step.
Every tool has a documented permission check outside the model.
The injection test case has a defined, blocked outcome.
The design names what memory is stored and when it is deleted.
